description: The Boat Aavante Prime X delivers an enjoyable home theatre experience, particularly when watching action-heavy films or playing games. Its powerful bass and rear speakers create a convincing sense of immersion, while dialogue remains clear even when plenty is happening on screen. Music playback is respectable too, although the overall tuning favours movies and games. Some non-Dolby content can produce an occasional echo, and the large setup needs plenty of room. The Boat Aavante Prime X isn't perfect, but it gets the important stuff right, and that counts for quite a bit.
title: Boat Aavante Prime X Review: Big, Loud and Surprisingly Good

description: As one of the world's leading social platforms, Instagram offers far more than simple photo and video sharing. From editing and saving images offline to customising your profile fonts and scheduling future content, the platform is packed with useful features. A few years ago, the Meta-owned platform launched its in-app post-scheduling tool. As the name suggests, it allows users to schedule posts. This feature can especially be helpful for content creators as it cuts down time spent on repetitive tasks, while also eliminating the risk of forgetting or missing their best times to post.
title: How to Schedule Posts on Instagram: A Step-by-Step Guide

description: WhatsApp allows users to send high-quality photos and videos over its instant messaging platform. The company added the ability three years ago, in August 2023. HD images and videos retain more details, textures, and depth, as they were intended to have. WhatsApp uses a compression algorithm to compress files into smaller file sizes and send them over the internet quickly. However, the level of compression is reduced notably when a media file is sent in high-quality. Similarly, images and videos that are already of a lower quality might appear pixelated and blurred. However, if sent as high-quality files, these issues could be reduced significantly.
title: How to Send High-Quality Photos and Videos on WhatsApp: A Step-by-Step Guide

description: Creators can choose from several free or free-tier AI video editors depending on the type of content they make. CapCut offers tools for captions, background removal and noise reduction, while InVideo AI can build videos from scripts and prompts. YouTube Create adds AI-assisted editing and video generation for mobile users, including creators in India. DaVinci Resolve provides a more advanced desktop editing setup for longer projects. However, free plans can have restrictions such as limited AI usage, watermarked exports or locked features.
title: Best Free AI Video Editing Apps for Creators in India: CapCut, InVideo and More
